name: Device Concealment & Placement
description: A hardware implant is only as effective as its placement. Devices placed in obvious locations will be discovered during the next cleaning cycle or security sweep. Effective placement leverages environmental features — ceiling tiles, behind mounted equipment, inside cable management trays, beneath raised flooring, within junction boxes — that are infrequently accessed. If accidentally discovered, the device should appear as plausible infrastructure rather than foreign hardware.

blue.det: Physical discovery during security sweep; RF emissions from device; visual inspection of unusual objects in facility.
blue.cm: Regular physical security sweeps including ceiling spaces and utility areas; TSCM for high-security areas; RF monitoring; photograph and document all equipment in sensitive areas.
